testimonials.name: Sierra
testimonials.quote:
I had one of the most incredible experiences at the Zion Bonsai succulent workshop. From the moment we walked in, the space felt welcoming, clean, bright, and absolutely beautiful; it instantly set the tone for something special. I went with my husband, and it turned into such a meaningful and fun experience for both of us.

The class itself was hands-on in the best way. We learned how to plant, grow, and replant succulent bonsai, and I loved being able to actually do everything rather than just watch. There was something so grounding about getting my hands in the soil and reconnecting with nature. It truly felt rejuvenating and helped me unplug from everything else.

One of the best parts was leaving with our own bonsai plant, which we named Fez (yes, a little Doctor Who inspiration!). It’s more than just a plant; it’s something we now get to nurture, care for, and connect with. There’s a real sense of meaning behind it, especially with the idea of wabi-sabi, imperfectly perfect, which made the experience feel even more special.

Cassey and Landon are absolutely wonderful. They are not only incredibly knowledgeable but also kind, patient, and genuinely passionate about what they do. They teach through experience, make everything approachable, and answer every question with care. What really stood out is how they continue to stay connected even after the workshop. They’re always open to answering follow-up questions, which shows how much they truly care about their students and their plants.

This workshop wasn’t just a class, it was an experience I’ll remember and appreciate for a long time. I can’t recommend it highly enough!
